title: The Blank Badge
summary: Sam, the new night clerk, is given one rule by Mr. Harlow: never say your name. A soaked girl asks for his name anyway. Sam almost answers, and the lights go out. Cliffhanger: 1 answer her, 2 stay silent.

beats.action: Sam alone behind the desk at midnight.

lines.text: This hotel has *no floor 13*. Tonight, someone asks for it.

beats.action: Mr. Harlow walks in from the entrance and stops at the desk.

lines.text: At midnight, the *old manager* walks in. He keeps his coat on.

beats.action: Mr. Harlow points at Sam and gives the rule.
The empty hallway. Every door closed. A light flickers.

lines.text: Long halls. Dim lights. *Every door* closed.

beats.action: A soaked little girl stands at the desk on a dry night.
Close on Sam's face. His mouth opens. The lights die.

lines.text: You open your mouth. And the *lights go out*.

publish.title: The Blank Badge - a night shift story
publish.description: You are the new night clerk. One rule.
